method.critical_note: detect 只解析内联样式。Next.js 静态导出把 CSS 写在 out/_next/static/css/ 外部文件里，因此扫描 out/ 目录或其 HTML 得到的是【假阴性】——看不见任何样式规则。必须单独扫描导出的 CSS 文件。

positive_controls.note: 先证明检测器在工作，再采信阴性结果。
positive_controls.inline_html_control: 故意违规的内联 <style> 文件 → 8 条发现
positive_controls.external_css_control: 故意违规的 .css 文件 → 1 条发现（gradient-text）

findings.description: Gradient text is decorative rather than meaningful — a common AI tell, especially on headings and metrics. Use solid colors for text.
Text does not meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text). Increase the contrast between text and background.
Text does not meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text). Increase the contrast between text and background.

Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.
Dominant heading and body roles are separated by less than 1.25× at every step, leaving the size hierarchy flat. Add at least one stronger size step.
findings.snippet: Role sizes: body 16px, h1 16px, h3 16px (largest adjacent step 1.00:1; target 1.25:1)

findings.description: Heading levels should not skip (e.g. h1 then h3 with no h2). Screen readers use heading hierarchy for navigation. Skipping levels breaks the document outline.
findings.snippet: <h1> "紫气东来" followed by <h3> "卡片标题" (missing h2)

findings.description: Purple/violet gradients and cyan-on-dark are the most recognizable tells of AI-generated UIs. Choose a distinctive, intentional palette.

known_warnings_not_suppressed.note: 404 的 11px/11.5px 用于票眉与版权行。该字号是本世界票眉/字段标签的排印习惯；主站用了 19 处而 detect 报 0 条——检测器自身在同类用法上判定不一致。按非阻塞警告记录，未做任何 suppress（未使用 ignore、未改值规避）。
